topic: Sue, the most complete T. rex
script: The most complete T. rex ever found is named Sue. It was discovered in South Dakota in 1990 by Sue Hendrickson. About 90 percent of its skeleton by volume was recovered. In 1997, it sold at auction for about 8.4 million dollars. Sue is now on display at the Field Museum in Chicago. It is about 12 meters long. Follow DinoBytes for more prehistoric facts.
